"The pandemic has shown clearly we have to have more points of outreach to people, so they actually get the care they need in a setting that they're comfortable with..."

Learn how the @VimClackamas clinic move to @ClackCollege will better serve health needs in our communities.⬇️
🚨 A reminder – tomorrow, January 15 is the last day to sign up for quality, affordable health insurance through @ORMarketplace. Preview plans and sign up today. ⬇️
I am calling on the Senate to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act without delay because everyone must be free to make the best decisions for themselves, their families and their lives.

Had the opportunity to meet with @SOORstate during #SOHillDay to discuss the importance of inclusive health, education, and sports. Thank you for the life changing work and programs that you provide for Oregonians! https://t.co/iy1i9waqr2

I met with Planned Parenthood leadership at their Milwaukie clinic to discuss reproductive healthcare issues in Congress. Thank you @PPCW for providing vital healthcare services in our community and for having me today! https://t.co/Lwp5KiSS3f

As a proud member of @ProChoiceCaucus, I'm deeply disappointed the Senate failed to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act to enshrine abortion access into law. I pledge to keep fighting to ensure all Americans' reproductive rights are protected, no matter where they live. #WHPA

Today, @SenateFinance held a hearing on my plan to lower drug prices. I'm Proud to hear my Senate colleagues speak in support of issues I championed including allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices. Let's get these provisions across the finish line for #OR05 & all Americans!

In today’s @EnergyCommerce hearing I expressed concerns with pharma's continuing games to avoid the ability for pharmacists to provide lower cost options to patients at the counter & explained how my bill will reign this practice in, increase competition, & reward innovation. https://t.co/dXfnSuwA00

12 years ago the #AffordableCareAct was signed into law. I have long supported the #ACA which has helped cut Oregon's uninsured rate in half & provides 146K Oregonians with affordable coverage. I will continue to work to strengthen, protect, & lower health costs for all in #OR05.

Today, I voted to cap the price of insulin at $35/month to help deliver financial relief for Oregonians who depend on this life saving medication. 
 
Before it passed, I spoke on the House floor in support of this and other provisions that I secured in the BBB drug pricing plan. https://t.co/T1KY78kQTu

Proud to introduce bipartisan legislation with @RepGuthrie and @RepMullin that allows for a value based payment model so that folks with severely debilitating conditions can access new, innovative, life-changing treatments and cures through Medicaid. https://t.co/dDAA8vp3BA

In today's @EnergyCommerce Health Subcommittee hearing I spoke in support of @POTUS FY23 budget request that includes a policy I am championing to expedite the generic drug application process. https://t.co/4TEwVj0Y4l

Without action, millions of women will lose access to safe reproductive care and services. It's time for the Senate to immediately pass the Women’s Health Protection Act to codify #Roe into law and safeguard reproductive rights.
https://t.co/kVRQryjNqa

It is an honor to have U.S. Department of Health and Human Services @SecBecerra here in Oregon during #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth. 

Listen into our roundtable discussion on youth mental health with @OregonGovBrown, @repblumenauer, and @RepBonamici. ⬇
https://t.co/Sp4sgZctG6

It was an honor to host @SecBecerra for a roundtable on youth mental health today for #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth. I also want to thank the YouthLine volunteers we met with who are on the front line providing crisis support to address the mental health crisis in our community. https://t.co/g2hXZK4jgL

Next, @SecBecerra and I hosted a roundtable @PortlandCC with @OregonGovBrown on the healthcare workforce pipeline. We discussed how Oregon institutions are finding ways to provide good paying jobs in #OR05 and reduce the healthcare workforce shortage. https://t.co/YxJFJv2E3Z

.@PPFA in Oregon will play a pivotal role in providing reproductive health services to patients who can not access in their home states. It's time for the Senate to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act to safeguard reproductive rights for everyone regardless of where they live.

Federal firefighters and EMS personnel make significant sacrifices and take incredible risks in service to their communities. I voted to ensure that these brave first responders have access to the same workers compensation and health benefits as other professional firefighters. https://t.co/xSjFldwMmn

I am closely monitoring the infant formula supply status, and will continue to work to ensure Oregon families can access safe, affordable infant formula and nutrition products. Info about how to obtain formula, food bank locations, and more here. ⬇
https://t.co/98GhyLI1zX

Today, I spoke in support of the Water Resources Development Act. This bipartisan legislation includes funding that I championed to replace the Big Creek Dam in Newport, invests in our water and wastewater treatment systems, and will help address dredging delays along the Coast. https://t.co/TTeFOzw9t8

I voted for a bipartisan package to extend & strengthen programs that support mental health & substance use disorder prevention, care, treatment, & recovery. This includes provisions that I have championed to lower drug prices by bringing transparency to the PBM industry.

My drug price reduction framework will:
✅Allow Medicare to negotiate drug prices
✅End price increases beyond the rate of inflation
✅Establish a $2,000 out-of-pocket cap
✅Reduce the deficit by $300 billion

I am pleased to see @CMSgov approve Oregon’s Medicaid Section 1115 request! 

This decision will unlock new federal funding and initiatives to:
✅Expand access to coverage
✅Ensure continuous coverage for children until the age of six
✅Address social determinants of health
